content.context: This milestone follows the Phase 1 canonical-store groundwork and the project architecture rebuild docs. Phase 2 replaces the old parallel/label-fragmented memory backend with a project-local canonical store and rebuildable search projections. Migration was deliberately scoped to the two PITMRY labels; unrelated projects and legacy records were left untouched. The Phase 2 changes are present in the working tree, not in the captured Git commit.
content.decision: Use .pitmry/memory-dashboard as the canonical project store, with SQLite/FTS and LanceDB as rebuildable projections; migrate only explicitly selected PITMRY labels and preserve source identities and duplicate history.
content.rationale: Canonical records are the source of truth; SQLite/FTS and LanceDB are derived projections rebuilt from that source. Scoped migration limits cross-project contamination, stable record identity makes retries safe, full Git SHAs preserve reference integrity, and retaining duplicate summaries avoids silently discarding source history.
content.summary: Implemented the Phase 2 canonical PITMRY backend in this repository. Established .pitmry/memory-dashboard as the project manifest/store; migrated only legacy Cavemem records labeled pitmry and memory-dashboard (9 ADRs, 0 Grill logs, 14 Git digests; 23 records total); resolved all 14 Git references to full SHAs; preserved five duplicate commit summaries; and confirmed a repeat migration returns the same 23 IDs. Rebuilt the SQLite/FTS projection with 23/23 records and integrity check ok, plus one LanceDB records table with 23 vectors. The server test suite passed: 111 tests. Changes remain uncommitted; HEAD is only the captured base revision.
